summary: This tutorial introduces LibreOffice Impress, a free and open-source presentation software. It covers installation on GNU/Linux with LibreOffice version 3.3.4, or using the Synaptic Package Manager for other systems. Key features include various toolbars such as Title bars, Menu bars, Formatting bars, and Status bars. The tutorial demonstrates creating a new presentation by selecting a template, customizing it with a name, subject, and design, and saving it in the ODP format. It also explains how to save Impress presentations as Microsoft PowerPoint files for compatibility. Additional steps include creating a new presentation, navigating through toolbars, and exporting PDF documents from Impress.
